LESSON: MAKING TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.5: MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we paint?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify painting materials
2. paint freely on paper for familiarization of materials
3. use finger technique for painting
4. paint freely for enjoyment e) appreciate own and others painted work paintings . Core-Competence Health Education: Personal Hygiene

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify painting materials
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify painting materials. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. paint freely on paper for familiarization of materials
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to paint freely on paper for familiarization of materials. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. use finger technique for painting
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use finger technique for painting. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. paint freely for enjoyment e) appreciate own and others painted work paintings . Core-Competence Health Education: Personal Hygiene
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to paint freely for enjoyment e) appreciate own and others painted work paintings . Core-Competence Health Education: Personal Hygiene. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about MAKING TECHNIQUES.
2. Explain MAKING TECHNIQUES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand MAKING TECHNIQUES.
4. Show that you can: identify painting materials
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about MAKING TECHNIQUES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why do we paint?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify painting materials
2. paint freely on paper for familiarization of materials
3. use finger technique for painting
4. paint freely for enjoyment e) appreciate own and others painted work paintings . Core-Competence Health Education: Personal Hygiene

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
